We are pleased to announce that our Annual Sports Day _________ on 30th April, 2025 at the school playground from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. (A) is held (B) will be held (C) had been held (D) to be held
solution: (B) will be held

subject: English
question: Complete the slogan on ‘‘Save Earth’’, by filling in the blank with the correct option. Lets join hands, cultivate conservation, and _________ a greener tomorrow for generations to come. (A) ensuring (B) ensure (C) ensures (D) ensured
solution: (B) ensure

subject: English
question: Identify the error and supply the correction for the following note in an air purifier’s instruction manual. The plug should fit upto the outlet. If it doesn’t fit, do not force it in. Use the given format for your response. Error Correction
solution: Error: upto; Correction: up to

subject: English
question: You are Soumya Hansal / Sumit Hansal living at F-32, Shanti Nagar, Vayugarh. Seeing the inadequate healthcare infrastructure in your town, write a letter to the MLA of your area, in about 120 words, suggesting the need for improving existing healthcare facilities and creating more ‘‘Wellness Centres’’ including a specialized hospital for children and women.
solution: Write a formal letter to the MLA explaining the inadequate healthcare infrastructure and requesting improved existing facilities, more Wellness Centres, and a specialised hospital for children and women.

subject: English
question: You are Risha Khan / Zuhaan Khan, the sports captain of Highrise Public School, New Line, Rai Nagar. You believe that games and sports are an integral part of a student’s life. Write a letter to the editor of a national daily, in about 120 words, sharing your views on the importance of physical education and suggesting the need to establish a dedicated sports university, so that students can pursue and focus on their favourite sport.
solution: Write a formal letter to the editor explaining the importance of physical education and requesting a dedicated sports university where students can develop and pursue their chosen sports professionally.

subject: English
question: In the past few years, the teaching-learning process has taken a leap and gone beyond the four walls of the classroom. Today, it has become possible to learn not just by sitting in a physical classroom, but from anywhere. Given below is a chart depicting the differences between E-learning and Classroom learning. Write an analytical paragraph in about 120 words, assessing the benefits and drawbacks of both, by selecting features that support your analysis. E-learning vs. Classroom learning • accessible anytime anywhere • at your own pace • no travel costs, saves time • same place, same time • caters to the needs of the class • transportation cost and time consuming
solution: E-learning offers flexibility, accessibility, self-paced study and savings in travel time and cost. Classroom learning provides a common place and time, direct interaction and teaching suited to the needs of the class, but involves transportation costs and time. Both have advantages and limitations depending on learners’ needs.

subject: English
question: Read the given details of a computer. * electronic device that can store and process information * makes life easy and simple * physical description — monitor, keyboard, CPU and mouse * computer technology used in all fields — education, medicine, commerce, entertainment Analyse the details and write an analytical paragraph in about 120 words about the description and role of computers in today’s world.
solution: A computer is an electronic device that stores and processes information and makes life easier. Its main physical components include a monitor, keyboard, CPU and mouse. Computer technology is widely used in education, medicine, commerce and entertainment. It has become an essential tool for communication, learning, professional work and managing information.

subject: English
question: Why were there no leaves left on the trees ? (A) The locusts ate them up. (B) An earthquake had occurred. (C) There was a hailstorm. (D) The animals grazed on them.
solution: (C) There was a hailstorm.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with the correct word from the brackets. Lencho felt __________ (jubilant/devastated) when he saw his destroyed corn fields.
solution: devastated

subject: English
question: When Lencho says, ‘‘All our work, for nothing,’’ what does he refer to ? Explain in about 40 words.
solution: Lencho refers to the months of hard work he and his family had put into cultivating the corn. The hailstorm destroyed the entire crop, making their labour, hopes of a harvest and means of livelihood seem wasted.

subject: English
question: Why would Lencho have preferred a plague of locusts to a hailstorm ?
solution: Lencho believed that a plague of locusts would have left at least some of the crop, whereas the hailstorm had completely destroyed everything.

subject: English
question: What does the following line tell us about the character of Anil ? “I think he knew I made a little money this way but he did not seem to mind.”
solution: It shows that Anil was kind, trusting and generous. He understood Hari’s small dishonesty but chose not to make an issue of it.

subject: English
question: Which of the following best describes the realization Hari Singh had while working for Anil ? (A) that he would become a rich person one day (B) that Anil was a very intelligent master but a miser (C) that he would be able to accomplish a lot if he gets educated (D) that Anil made a lot of money from his job
solution: (C) that he would be able to accomplish a lot if he gets educated

subject: English
question: What did Anil promise to teach Hari Singh, and how did Hari Singh feel about the opportunity to learn ? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: Anil promised to teach Hari to cook, write his name, write complete sentences and add numbers. Hari felt grateful and hopeful because he realised that education could open unlimited opportunities for him.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with the correct word from the brackets. The narrator earned extra money by making a/an _________ (profit/investment) of about a rupee a day.
solution: profit

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence appropriately : The speaker addresses the person he is speaking to as ‘‘my dear’’ because ___________.
solution: the speaker is addressing Anne affectionately and personally.

subject: English
question: The poet mentions ‘‘yellow hair’’. What is its significance in the context of the statement ? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: The yellow hair represents Anne’s physical beauty and outward appearance. The speaker suggests that human beings may be attracted by such external beauty, whereas God can love a person for inner qualities rather than physical appearance.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with the correct word from the brackets. The poet suggests that God’s love in comparison to that of a human being is ____________ (selfish/selfless).
solution: selfless

subject: English
question: As per the above extract, what attributes does God not love a person for ? Select the correct option. 1. Wealth 2. Physical appearance 3. Intelligence 4. Inner qualities 5. Youth (A) 1 and 4 (B) 3, 4, and 5 (C) 2 and 4 (D) Only 4
solution: (C) 2 and 4

subject: English
question: Identify and name any one figure of speech in the above extract.
solution: One figure of speech is alliteration, as seen in phrases such as ‘pads of velvet’ and ‘quiet rage’, where repeated consonant sounds create a musical effect.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with one word. The tiger’s stalking on ‘pads of velvet’ suggests a movement that is ___________.
solution: silent

subject: English
question: Based on the given lines from the poem, which words would best describe the feelings of the tiger ? (A) Calm and content (B) Both subdued and angry (C) Both frustrated and happy (D) Both angry and famished
solution: (B) Both subdued and angry

subject: English
question: Select the option that applies the same rhyme scheme as the first four lines of the given extract. (A) The people along the sand / All turn and look one way / They turn their back on the land / They look at the sea all day (B) Along the sand, the people / All turn and look one way / They turn back on the sand / They look at the sea all day (C) The people along the sand / Look one way and all turn / Their backs on the land / They look at the sea all day (D) The people along the sand / They turn their back on the land / They look one way / At the sea all day.
solution: (A) The rhyme scheme is ABAB, matching the first four lines of the extract.

subject: English
chapter: Nelson Mandela – Long Walk to Freedom
question: Mandela in his speech says, ‘‘The policy of apartheid created a deep and lasting wound in my country and my people.’’ Explain the significance of the word ‘‘wound’’ as used by Mandela.
solution: ‘Wound’ is used metaphorically to describe the deep physical, emotional and social suffering caused by apartheid. It represents racial discrimination, oppression, loss of freedom and the lasting damage done to South African society.

subject: English
question: ‘Dust of Snow’, by Robert Frost is a poem about nature and simplicity. Elaborate.
solution: The poem shows how a simple natural event can bring a positive change in a person’s mood. The falling dust of snow from a hemlock tree refreshes the poet and saves part of his day, highlighting nature’s quiet power.

subject: English
question: Explain the reasons for Rajvir’s excitement on seeing the plantation and Pranjol’s lack of enthusiasm. (Glimpses of India – Tea from Assam)
solution: Rajvir was excited because he was seeing the vast tea gardens for the first time and was fascinated by their beauty and history. Pranjol, a native of Assam, had grown up among tea plantations, so they were ordinary and familiar to him.

subject: English
question: Analyze how Wells employs humour, rhyme, and exaggerated traits to not only entertain, but also educate readers about various wild animals. Explain. (How to Tell Wild Animals)
solution: Wells uses rhyme, humour and exaggerated descriptions to make identifying dangerous animals amusing and memorable. The playful warnings about how each animal might attack teach readers about their distinctive features while keeping the poem entertaining.

subject: English
question: Mijbil’s transportation to England was no less than a nightmare for the author. Justify the statement using incidents from the lesson. (Mijbil the Otter)
solution: The journey was difficult because Mijbil escaped from his box, damaged the airline compartment and had to be carried by the author. The airline staff and passengers created additional difficulties, making the journey stressful and frightening for the author.

subject: English
question: Analyze how Herriot uses Tricki and Mrs. Pumphrey’s relationship to comment on societal attitudes towards pets and the responsibilities associated with their care. (A Triumph of Surgery)
solution: Mrs. Pumphrey’s excessive affection and overfeeding show how pets can be spoiled through misguided care. Herriot demonstrates that responsible pet ownership requires discipline, exercise and a balanced diet rather than excessive indulgence.

subject: English
chapter: The Book That Saved the Earth
question: Today reading books is on the decline because of the prevalence of electronic media. Contrarily, earth is saved by a ‘Book’ in the chapter ‘‘The Book That Saved the Earth’’. Elaborate.
solution: The play humorously shows the power of books and knowledge when a nursery rhyme book saves Earth from invasion. Think-Tank’s misunderstanding of the book causes him to retreat, showing that books can influence events and contain valuable knowledge.

subject: English
question: Discuss the character development of Griffin, as he grapples with the repercussions of his actions and attempts to navigate a world, where his once extraordinary abilities have become a burden. (Footprints without Feet)
solution: Griffin’s scientific ability makes him powerful, but he increasingly misuses invisibility for theft, revenge and violence. His actions isolate him and turn his extraordinary discovery into a burden, revealing the destructive consequences of using science without morality.

subject: English
question: Amanda and Valli both represent a longing for freedom. Examine the above observation with reference to the two texts. (Amanda and Madam Rides the Bus)
solution: Amanda longs for freedom from constant instructions and imagines herself living independently. Valli seeks freedom through her desire to travel alone by bus and experience the world beyond her village. Amanda’s freedom is largely imaginative, while Valli actively plans and fulfils her wish. Both characters value independence and escape from restrictions, though their circumstances and methods differ.

subject: English
chapter: The Ball Poem and Nelson Mandela – Long Walk to Freedom
question: In ‘The Ball Poem’’, Berryman explores the themes of loss, growing up, and transformation. Mandela also experienced loss of freedom and suffering along with his countrymen during his growing years on the basis of his race and colour. Compare and contrast the commonality of themes in both the texts. (The Ball Poem and Nelson Mandela – Long Walk to Freedom)
solution: Both texts portray loss as an experience that leads to maturity and transformation. The boy in The Ball Poem learns to accept personal loss and responsibility, while Mandela experiences the loss of freedom under apartheid and grows into a leader committed to equality. Both show that suffering can develop understanding, courage and maturity.

subject: English
question: Horace ends up in prison only to regret that a man should not trust anyone blindly without finding out the truth. Do you think his own foolishness was responsible for his arrest ? Give a reasoned answer. (A Question of Trust)
solution: Yes. Horace was intelligent and careful, but he trusted the woman who pretended to be the owner of the house. He accepted her false story without verification and opened the safe for her. His overconfidence and failure to question her identity ultimately led to his arrest.

subject: English
question: Matilda’s character embodies the journey of change or progression throughout the story, encapsulating the transformations she endured as a consequence of her experiences, trials, and engagements with other characters. In the light of the above information, trace the transformation seen in Matilda’s character in the story. (The Necklace)
solution: Matilda begins as a dissatisfied woman obsessed with wealth and social status. Losing the necklace forces her and her husband into years of hardship and labour. These experiences make her practical, hardworking and resilient. Her transformation is tragic because she finally learns the truth that the original necklace was only an imitation.

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence appropriately. The characteristic aroma and flavour of cinnamon originate from its essential oil, primarily composed of ___________.
solution: cinnamaldehyde

subject: English
question: Based on the reading of the passage, examine, in about 40 words, how cinnamon derived from the trees is made fit to be used as a spice.
solution: The stems of cinnamon trees are cut, the inner bark is extracted and the woody parts are removed. The bark is then dried into curled strips called cinnamon sticks, which can also be ground into cinnamon powder.

subject: English
question: Mention one point of difference between Ceylon cinnamon and Cassia cinnamon.
solution: Ceylon cinnamon comes from Sri Lanka and is sweeter and lighter in flavour, whereas Cassia comes from southern China and has a richer, somewhat bitter flavour.

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence appropriately. The author says that cinnamon was once more valuable than gold because ___________.
solution: it was highly prized and was sought for important religious and embalming practices and later became a very profitable spice in trade.

subject: English
question: What is the tone of the writer in the given lines from paragraph (5)? Rationalize your response in about 40 words. “Cinnamon is a spice that has been prized for its medicinal properties for thousands of years.”
solution: The tone is appreciative and informative. The writer highlights the long-recognised medicinal value of cinnamon and presents its health-related uses positively while maintaining an informative style.

subject: English
question: The writer’s use of the phrases ‘modern science has started to confirm’ in paragraph (5) and ‘more evidence is needed to confirm’ in paragraph (6) suggests that the benefits of cinnamon are: 1. proven 2. scientific 3. uncertain 4. controversial 5. harmful. Select the correct option: (A) 1 and 3 (B) 2 and 4 (C) only 3 (D) only 5
solution: (C) only 3

subject: English
question: Which of the following statements about cinnamon and its health benefits is true? (A) Modern science has evidence to prove that cinnamon has many anti-diabetic properties, and it offers complete protection from cancer and cardiovascular disease. (B) Cinnamon lacks antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it unsuitable for dental hygiene products. (C) Antioxidants found in cinnamon have no effect on free radicals in the body. (D) Cinnamon’s anti-inflammatory properties are being researched for its potential benefits in Alzheimer’s disease, irritable bowel syndrome and colon cancer.
solution: (D) Cinnamon’s anti-inflammatory properties are being researched for its potential benefits in Alzheimer’s disease, irritable bowel syndrome and colon cancer.

subject: English
question: Which of the following statements best describes the author’s attitude toward cinnamon and its uses? (A) Finds cinnamon to be a prized condiment which can be used in almost all food items. (B) Believes that cinnamon should be used by everyone, everyday. (C) Recognizes that cinnamon has many useful properties, including health benefits. (D) Believes that cinnamon should only be used as a medicinal supplement.
solution: (C) Recognizes that cinnamon has many useful properties, including health benefits.

subject: English
question: What does the use of the phrase ‘prioritise domestic destinations’ by the writer, in paragraph (1) imply? (A) Indian tourists prefer places in the country itself. (B) Indian tourists like to stay at home. (C) Indian tourists mainly travel on low budgets. (D) Indian tourists love to hitch-hike and trek.
solution: (A) Indian tourists prefer places in the country itself.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blanks with the appropriate option from those given in brackets, based on your understanding of paragraph (2). The statement that, World Migration Report highlights significant migration flows from India to the United Arab Emirates, the United States, and Saudi Arabia, is a/an ________ (fact/opinion) because it is a/an __________ (subjective judgement/objective detail).
solution: fact; objective detail

subject: English
question: Draw a comparative analysis of domestic tourists travelling within India with domestic tourists travelling outside India in 2022. Answer in about 40 words.
solution: Domestic tourism was far greater, with about 1.7 billion visits within India, while only about 21 million Indians travelled internationally. This shows a strong preference for domestic travel, although outbound tourism to destinations such as the UAE was also significant.

subject: English
question: Complete the following with a suitable reason. Gulf states rank as popular destinations for Indians _________.
solution: because they are relatively accessible and are also major destinations for Indian migrants and visitors.

subject: English
question: Select the option that is true for the Assertion and Reason given below: Assertion: Indians prioritize Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh for domestic tourism. Reason: These states are full of historical monuments. (A) Both the Assertion and Reason are true and the Reason is the correct explanation of the Assertion. (B) Both the Assertion and Reason are true but the Reason is not the correct explanation of the Assertion. (C) The Assertion is true, but the Reason is false. (D) The Assertion is false, but the Reason is true.
solution: (C) The Assertion is true, but the Reason is false.

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence appropriately. The fourthmost visited outbound destination for Indians to the Gulf is _________.
solution: Kuwait

subject: English
question: Mention any two reasons for domestic tourism becoming popular.
solution: It suits travellers’ budgets and allows them to explore India’s historical and cultural diversity.

subject: English
question: What is the writer’s view about the tourism industry in the west? Write any two points.
solution: Western destinations such as the United States and the United Kingdom attract Indian tourists by offering a mix of traditional and contemporary experiences, unique cuisines and diverse landscapes.

subject: English
question: Identify the word in paragraph (3) that indicates the ‘preference’ of people travelling to the Gulf.
solution: popularity

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank by using the correct form of the word in the brackets, for the given portion of a letter. I believe that with your support and ________ (cooperate), we can find a mutually agreeable solution that meets the expectations of all stakeholders involved.
solution: cooperation

subject: English
question: Read the given sentence from an electric cooker’s instruction manual. Identify the error and supply the correction in the sentence. For avoid damaging the appliance, do not immerse the electric cooker in water or any other liquid.
solution: Error: For; Correction: To

subject: English
question: Amit and Pallavi had a conversation about the inauguration of Pallavi’s event. Report Amit’s question. Did you manage to get any sponsors for the inauguration event scheduled for the next month?
solution: Amit asked Pallavi if she had managed to get any sponsors for the inauguration event scheduled for the following month.

subject: English
question: Read the dialogue between Bharti and her mother, Geeta, regarding Geeta’s birthday plans. Bharti: Do you want to go to a hill station on your birthday? Geeta: No, I want to stay at home and call my friends over. Select the correct option that reports the above dialogue. Bharti asked Geeta if she wanted to go to a hill station on her birthday. Geeta replied in the negative and said that __________. (A) she wanted to stay home and call her friends for celebrating. (B) I wanted to stay home and call my friends to celebrate. (C) she wanted to stay at home and call her friends over. (D) she wants to stay home by calling her friends to celebrate.
solution: (C) she wanted to stay at home and call her friends over.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank by choosing the correct option, to complete the line of a notice placed on the notice board of a company. Please be informed that there will be a staff meeting in the conference room on Friday, 7th June, at 10:00 a.m. It is __________ for all to attend. (mandatory/obligatory/indispensable)
solution: mandatory

subject: English
question: Identify the error and supply correction for the given sentence from a preface of a book. Writing this book have been a journey of exploration and discovery.
solution: Error: have; Correction: has

subject: English
question: Select the option that identifies the error and supplies the correction for the opening line, from an analytical paragraph. The advent of social media has revolutionized communication by connected people across the globe in unprecedented ways. (A) has-have (B) communication-communicating (C) connected-connecting (D) in-for
solution: (C) connected — connecting

subject: English
question: Complete the given entry in a personal diary, by filling the blank with the correct option. Today was a rollercoaster of emotions. It started off with a sense of excitement and anticipation as I __________ on a new project at work. (A) embarking (B) embark (C) embarked (D) have embarked
solution: (C) embarked

subject: English
question: Report the dialogue between a salesman and his customer, by completing the sentence. Salesman: I have a wide range of sportswear. Customer: Please show me something in cotton fabric, which is suitable for summers. The salesman stated ____________. The customer requested the salesman to show something in cotton fabric which would be suitable for summers.
solution: that he had a wide range of sportswear.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank by choosing the correct option to complete an announcement on a flight. In thirty minutes, our flight attendants ________ meal service. (A) will began (B) will begin (C) should begin (D) can begin
solution: (B) will begin

subject: English
question: Complete the line from a ‘Save the Environment’ song, by filling the blank with the correct option. Pollution, pollution, its time to take a stand, for the health of our planet, we’ve got to lend a hand, Reduce, reuse, recycle, that’s the key, ________ our world for you and me. (A) for preserve (B) to preserve (C) to preserved (D) for preserved
solution: (B) to preserve

subject: English
question: Identify the error and supply the correction for the following instruction put up for safe use of elevators. Please refrain by standing near the door as it could lead to an accident.
solution: Error: by; Correction: from

subject: English
question: As Anaisha/Anish Gupta of 84, Coral Apartment, Hoger Street, Viman Nagar, you feel that there has been a growing problem of illegal parking in the residential area of your neighbourhood, particularly near school and commercial establishments. This not only causes inconvenience to residents but also hampers the smooth flow of traffic and poses risks to pedestrians, especially children. Write a letter to the SHO of your city area, in about 120 words, stating the problem and requesting him to take necessary action for controlling the problem. Give suitable suggestions.
solution: Write a formal letter to the SHO describing illegal parking, its effects on traffic and pedestrians, and suggesting measures such as designated parking zones, enforcement, fines and regular monitoring.

subject: English
question: You are Yukti/Sanjay, the Head of Environment Club of Highways School, Hawapur. You feel concerned about the growing problem of single-use plastics and their detrimental impact on our environment. Their improper disposal is polluting our oceans, rivers and landscapes. Write a letter to the editor of a national daily, in about 120 words, suggesting measures to stop the use of single-use plastics to make a difference and mitigate the environmental impact of plastic pollution. Give suitable suggestions.
solution: Write a formal letter explaining the environmental damage caused by single-use plastics and suggesting bans or restrictions, reusable alternatives, recycling, public awareness and strict waste-management measures.

subject: English
question: Natural food, typically refers to food that has not been processed or preserved in any significant way before it is consumed, while ultra-processed food refers to food items that have been altered from their natural state through various methods. Given below is a table that differentiates between natural and processed foods. Study the description given and write an analytical paragraph in about 120 words, drawing a comparison between the two: Natural Food: High fibre, Healthy nutrients, Healthy fats, Low sodium, Regulates blood sugar, blood pressure and provides healthy nutrients. Processed Food: High sugar, Unhealthy nutrients, Unhealthy fats, High sodium, Tasty, ready to eat and addictive.
solution: Natural foods are nutritionally superior because they provide fibre, healthy nutrients and fats while remaining low in sodium and helping regulate blood sugar and blood pressure. Ultra-processed foods, though tasty and convenient, tend to contain high sugar, sodium and unhealthy fats. They may also become addictive. The comparison therefore favours natural foods for regular consumption, while processed foods should be limited.

subject: English
question: Social Media has a lasting impact on our thought process and influences our thinking in both positive and negative ways. With the help of the given cues and using your own ideas, write an analytical paragraph on “The Impact of Social Media on Teenagers’’ in about 120 words. POSITIVE: connects peers, creative expression, access information, community building. NEGATIVE: impacts self-esteem, cyber bullying, privacy intrusion, distraction and addiction.
solution: Social media has both beneficial and harmful effects on teenagers. It connects peers, encourages creative expression, provides access to information and helps build communities. However, excessive use can damage self-esteem, expose teenagers to cyberbullying and privacy risks, and cause distraction and addiction. Its impact therefore depends largely on responsible and balanced use.

subject: English
question: State any one inference about the parents of the baby seagull from the given statement. “His father and mother had come around calling to him shrilly, upbraiding him, threatening to let him starve on his ledge unless he flew away.”
solution: The parents were concerned about making the young seagull independent and were determined to push him to overcome his fear of flying.

subject: English
question: Where did the little seagull sleep at night?
solution: He slept in a little hole under the ledge.

subject: English
question: Which factors contributed to the young seagull’s reluctance to fly despite the encouragement and threats from his parents? Elaborate in about 40 words, with reference to the extract.
solution: The young seagull lacked confidence and believed that his wings would not support him. Seeing the plunge as desperate, he could not gather enough courage to leave the ledge even after watching his siblings fly.

subject: English
question: Which phrase or word would correctly substitute ‘muster up’ in the given sentence from the extract? He failed to ‘muster up’ courage to take that plunge which appeared to him so desperate. (A) review (B) resolve (C) distribute (D) gather
solution: (D) gather

subject: English
question: Why had the author made his plans in advance? (A) Mrs. Pumphrey was worried that Tricki would pine and die without her. (B) The author was aware of the severity of Tricki’s medical condition. (C) The author knew about Mrs. Pumphrey’s financial condition. (D) The author had planned his own vacation.
solution: (B) The author was aware of the severity of Tricki’s medical condition.

subject: English
question: The author firmly proposed the need to remove Tricki from the house for a specified period. Elaborate the reason for doing so in about 40 words.
solution: Tricki was seriously ill because of overfeeding and lack of exercise. Hospitalisation would remove him from Mrs. Pumphrey’s excessive pampering and allow a controlled diet, exercise and proper observation so that he could recover.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with the correct word from the brackets. The word ‘swooned’ in the following sentence indicates almost ________ (tripped/fainted).
solution: fainted

subject: English
question: “Mrs. Pumphrey was distraught.” What does this suggest about her character? Mention any one reason.
solution: It shows that she was extremely emotional and overprotective. She became deeply distressed at the thought of Tricki being separated from her and feared that he would die without her.

subject: English
question: The speaker offers evidence to support his preference for one theory over the other. Mention the evidence.
solution: The poet has personally experienced desire and therefore believes that the destructive power of desire can end the world in fire.

subject: English
question: What is the prediction of the poet about how the world will come to an end? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: The poet considers two possibilities: the world may end in fire, representing destructive desire, or in ice, representing hatred and coldness. He personally favours fire because he has experienced the destructive nature of desire.

subject: English
question: “Fire” and “Ice” are used in the poem as _______. (A) similes (B) metaphors (C) repetition (D) oxymorons
solution: (B) metaphors

subject: English
question: Comment on the overall mood of the extract.
solution: The mood is serious, contemplative and ominous because the poet reflects on destructive human emotions and the possible end of the world.

subject: English
question: How does the comparison between the boughs and newly discharged patients contribute to the theme or message of the poem? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: The comparison presents the trees as living beings escaping confinement. Like patients leaving a hospital after illness, the boughs move awkwardly towards freedom, reinforcing the poem’s theme of nature’s struggle to break free from human restrictions.

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence with the appropriate option. The imagery and descriptions in the poem create a mood of ______________________. (A) satisfaction and elation (B) transition and uncertainty (C) confusion and chaos (D) pessimism and certainty
solution: (B) transition and uncertainty

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with one word. The stiff movement of the twigs in the above extract suggests the ______________.
solution: struggle

subject: English
question: Why does the poet describe the bough as ‘shuffling’?
solution: The word ‘shuffling’ personifies the boughs and suggests their slow, awkward movement as they struggle to move out of the confined indoor space towards freedom.

subject: English
question: How was Mij to be transported to England?
solution: Mij was transported to England by air. Since animals were not allowed in the cabin, the airline provided a special box for him. He was carried in this box despite the difficulties caused by his restlessness.

subject: English
chapter: From the Diary of Anne Frank
question: Why did Anne think that paper has more patience than people?
solution: Anne felt that paper would patiently listen to her thoughts without interrupting, judging or criticising her. She did not feel that she had a true friend with whom she could share her deepest feelings, so she treated her diary as a confidante.

subject: English
question: How did the baker herald his arrival every morning?
solution: The baker announced his arrival by the jingling sound of the bamboo staff he carried. The children knew he had arrived when they heard the familiar ‘jhang, jhang’ sound and rushed to meet him.

subject: English
question: Describe how the poem ‘The Trees’ brings out the conflict between man and nature.
solution: The poem shows trees confined inside a house, symbolising human attempts to control nature. The trees struggle to escape towards the forest and regain their natural freedom, showing that nature ultimately resists artificial confinement.

subject: English
question: How did Valli manage to gather information about the bus ride she was planning?
solution: Valli carefully listened to conversations between passengers and people who travelled by bus. She asked discreet questions, learnt the distance, fare, travel time and route, and then planned her journey after saving the required money.

subject: English
question: How did Ausable get rid of Max?
solution: Ausable invented a story about a balcony outside his hotel-room window and then claimed the police were arriving. When there was a knock at the door, Max believed the story and jumped through the window expecting to land on the balcony, but fell to his death.

subject: English
question: Why does Mme Loisel hastily depart from the ball when her husband places a modest wrap on her shoulders?
solution: Mme Loisel was ashamed of the modest wrap because she felt it looked poor compared with the elegant clothes of the other women. She feared that people would notice her humble status, so she hurried away from the ball.

subject: English
question: “In time you will be more learned than anyone else in the village. Then no one will ever be able to laugh at you.” What effect did her teacher’s words have on Bholi? Elaborate.
solution: The teacher’s encouraging words gave Bholi confidence and self-respect. She began to believe in herself, overcome her fear and speak with courage. Education transformed her from a timid girl into a confident person capable of making her own decisions.

subject: English
chapter: A Letter to God and The Sermon at Benares
question: Analyse and evaluate the role of faith in ‘A Letter to God’ and ‘The Sermon at Benares’.
solution: Faith is central to both texts, but it takes different forms. Lencho has absolute faith in God and believes that God will help him after the hailstorm. Kisa Gotami initially believes she can overcome death by finding mustard seeds from a household untouched by death. Buddha teaches her that death is universal. Both texts show that faith can provide hope, but true understanding requires accepting reality and responding to suffering with wisdom.

subject: English
chapter: A Tiger in the Zoo and How to Tell Wild Animals
question: Explore the contrasting images of the tiger in ‘A Tiger in the Zoo’ and the tiger in ‘How to Tell Wild Animals’.
solution: In ‘A Tiger in the Zoo’, the tiger is presented as a powerful but imprisoned creature whose natural freedom has been taken away. Its quiet rage reflects the pain of captivity. In ‘How to Tell Wild Animals’, the tiger is presented humorously as a dangerous predator that can attack and kill humans. Thus, one poem evokes sympathy for a caged animal while the other uses humour to describe its wild danger.

subject: English
question: ‘Brilliant scientist though he was, Griffin was rather a lawless person.’ Elaborate.
solution: Griffin was a brilliant scientist because he discovered a method of making the human body invisible. However, he used his discovery irresponsibly and broke the law repeatedly. He burned his landlord’s house, stole clothes and money, frightened people and attacked others. His intelligence was therefore overshadowed by selfishness, violence and a complete lack of moral responsibility.

subject: English
question: How and when did Hari Singh meet Anil? Why did Hari Singh lie that he knew how to cook?
solution: Hari Singh met Anil at a wrestling match and introduced himself as a young writer looking for work. He lied that he knew how to cook because he wanted Anil to employ him. Although his first cooking was poor, Anil kept him and gradually taught him to read, write and live honestly.

subject: English
question: What does the writer’s use of phrases like ‘in urban regions kitchen gardens have garnered great acknowledgement’ suggest about kitchen gardening today ? (A) It has reduced inflation. (B) It is an expensive hobby. (C) It provides nutritious food. (D) It does not minimize adverse effects on the environment.
solution: (C) It provides nutritious food.

subject: English
question: Complete the following with a suitable explanation. Growing a kitchen garden is cost effective because __________.
solution: people can grow their own fresh produce at home using empty tins, old utensils and clay flower pots, thereby saving money and time.

subject: English
question: Identify two differences between the methods adopted in traditional farming and kitchen gardens. Paragraph (3)
solution: Traditional farming often uses synthetic fertilizers, pesticides and intensive irrigation, whereas kitchen gardens promote organic farming and reduce the use of harmful chemicals, helping preserve soil health.

subject: English
question: Substitute the underlined word with the correct word from Paragraph (4). The local residents’ nurturing of their surrounding flora and fauna helps to create awareness about civic responsibilities.
solution: care

subject: English
question: Tending to a kitchen garden has many health benefits. Explain in about 40 words. Paragraphs (4) and (5)
solution: Kitchen gardens provide fresh and organic produce rich in nutrients, vitamins and minerals. Gardening is also a physical activity that keeps people active, relieves stress and reduces the risk of obesity and related health problems.

subject: English
question: Select the option that best reflects the concept that kitchen gardening is an effective educational tool for children. (A) It contributes to effective community development. (B) It helps develop sensitivity and appreciation for nature.
solution: (B) It helps develop sensitivity and appreciation for nature.

subject: English
question: What hurdles do kitchen gardeners face ? Mention any two. Paragraph (7)
solution: Limited space and lack of sunlight.

subject: English
question: State whether the following statement is True or False: Kitchen gardening should be practised by everyone living in the cities.
solution: False.

subject: English
question: Silk is a popular fabric in India. Support the above statement in 40 words with evidence from the text.
solution: Silk has a long history in India and is known as Resham in eastern and northern India and Pattu in southern India. India is also the second largest producer of silk in the world after China.

subject: English
question: Select the option that is true for the assertion and reason given below. Assertion: Silk feels comfortable to the skin. Reason: It made of natural protein fibre. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true, but the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true, but the reason is false. (D) The assertion is false, but the reason is true.
solution: (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true, but the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion.

subject: English
question: Justify the following statement: Though one of the strongest natural fibres, silk remains stretched.
solution: Silk has moderate to poor elasticity, so even when it is elongated slightly, it remains stretched.

subject: English
question: According to the passage, in what way is sunlight harmful to silk ?
solution: Too much sunlight can weaken silk.

subject: English
question: ‘To produce 1 kg of silk, 104 kg of mulberry leaves must be eaten by 3000 silkworms.’ State any one inference that can be drawn from the above statement.
solution: Silk production requires a large quantity of mulberry leaves and a large number of silkworms.

subject: English
question: Complete the following with one suitable reason from the text: Silk production work can be carried out by skilled artisans because _________.
solution: the intensive work requires specialized knowledge, expertise and craftsmanship.

subject: English
question: Based on the given text, which state was the smallest producer of silk.
solution: Uttar Pradesh.

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence suitably. To carry out silk production requires careful selection because ___________.
solution: superior quality silk fabrics require long and uniform silk fibres.

subject: English
question: Give one reason to support why production of silk is limited.
solution: Silk production depends on factors such as climate, availability of quality mulberry leaves and the time required by silkworms to complete their lifecycle.

solution: (B) will

question: You are Falguni/Ashish residing at 98, Krystal Garden Apartments, Jonsabad. You have noticed that the swimming pool in your society is poorly maintained and has become a breeding ground for mosquitoes. As a resident and frequent user of the pool facilities, you feel deeply concerned about the potential health risks posed by the presence of mosquitoes. Write a letter, in about 120 words, to the Secretary of the RWA of your society, requesting him to take immediate action to address this issue to mitigate the problem.
solution: Write a formal letter describing the poorly maintained swimming pool, mosquito breeding and health risks, and request immediate cleaning, proper maintenance, regular chlorination and preventive measures.

You feel that the plots can be utilized to create green spaces where people can sit and relax. Write a letter to the editor of a national daily in about 120 words, highlighting the issue and urging necessary action from the concerned department for improving the aesthetic appeal of your city.
solution: Write a formal letter highlighting the neglected plots and suggesting their conversion into parks and green spaces, requesting the concerned department to take necessary action for better public spaces and city beautification.

subject: English
question: The effects of technology on education have been profound and multifaceted; influencing both teaching and learning in various ways. The data below shows the rising enrolment in online courses over the years. Analyze the data and write an analytical paragraph, in about 120 words, about how technology has transformed teaching and learning by shifting from classrooms to digital devices. Discuss benefits such as access to information and challenges like digital divide. S. No. Year Total number of enrolments (in millions) 1. 2017 26 2. 2018 43 3. 2019 59 4. 2020 76 5. 2021 143 6. 2022 189
solution: Online course enrolment increased consistently from 26 million in 2017 to 189 million in 2022. The sharpest growth occurred after 2020, showing the rapid shift towards digital education. Technology provides wider access to information, flexible learning and convenient digital resources. However, the digital divide, lack of devices and unequal internet access remain major challenges.

subject: English
question: Read the given details about the pros and cons of artificial intelligence (AI). With the help of the given cues and your own ideas write an analytical paragraph in about 120 words on “AI – Benefits and Drawbacks”. • AI is possessed by machines • Impacted our lives in many ways • AI – Google maps • Knowledge at our fingertips • Cannot wholly replicate humans • Increase in cyber crime
solution: Artificial intelligence has transformed modern life by making information and services easily accessible. Applications such as Google Maps help people navigate efficiently, while AI provides knowledge and automated assistance. However, machines cannot wholly replicate human judgement, creativity and emotions. Increased dependence on technology can also create privacy and cybersecurity concerns and may contribute to cyber crime. Thus, AI offers significant benefits but must be used responsibly with appropriate safeguards.

solution: (C) night

solution: The narrator is affectionate towards his family and is eagerly anticipating returning home to spend time with them.

solution: favourable

subject: English
question: How does the serene atmosphere described by the narrator contribute to the mood and anticipation of his journey back to England ? Elaborate in about 40 words, with reference to the extract.
solution: The clear sky, shining stars and sleeping countryside create a peaceful and calm atmosphere. This serenity makes the narrator feel happy and relaxed while flying, strengthening his anticipation and excitement about returning to England and meeting his family.

subject: English
question: What was the management supposed to do regarding the balcony ?
solution: The management had promised to block off the balcony.

subject: English

solution: (C) its accessibility from the neighbouring unit

subject: English
question: How does Ausable’s detailed explanation of the balcony’s history and current accessibility contribute to the atmosphere of suspense or tension in the story ? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: Ausable’s detailed explanation makes the balcony appear believable and creates tension because Max believes it provides an escape route. The explanation strengthens Ausable’s deception and prepares the reader for the unexpected turn in the story.

subject: English
question: Fill in the blank with the correct word from the brackets. The reference to ‘last month’ and ‘now’ adds to a sense of _________ (reconciliation/mystery).
solution: mystery

subject: English

solution: changing his gloomy mood and making him feel refreshed and positive.

subject: English
question: How does the interaction between the natural elements (crow, snow, hemlock tree) contribute to the speaker’s emotional transformation in the poem ? Answer in about 40 words.
solution: The crow shakes snow from the hemlock tree onto the poet. This simple natural incident unexpectedly changes his gloomy mood, making him feel refreshed and positive and saving the rest of his day from being wasted.

subject: English
question: ‘Dust of Snow’ is referred to as : (A) mist (B) dust of branches (C) snow residue (D) snowflakes
solution: (D) snowflakes

subject: English

solution: (D) 1, 4 and 5

subject: English
question: How does the poet reinforce the contrast between what the narrator wants and what Amanda desires ?
solution: The narrator wants Amanda to behave properly, sit straight and stop undesirable habits, whereas Amanda desires freedom and escape into an imaginary world where she can live peacefully and independently as a mermaid.

subject: English
question: What tone is conveyed through the repetition of Amanda’s name in the line ? (A) loving (B) instructive (C) indifferent (D) playful
solution: (B) instructive

subject: English
question: How does the imagery of the emerald sea with the mermaid contrast with Amanda’s actions ?
solution: The peaceful image of the emerald sea and mermaid represents Amanda’s desire for freedom and tranquillity, contrasting with the restrictions, instructions and disciplined behaviour imposed on her.

(A) Sitting by the pond / Waving my wand / Awaiting my dearest / I looked above and beyond / Awaiting my love / A sudden sound, fluttered the dove / The crackle stopped, as so did my heart (B) Sitting by the pond / Holding tight to my bond / I looked above and beyond / Awaiting my love / I heard her come, a sudden sound / The crackle stopped, as so did my heart (C) I sat beside the pond with her / Awaiting for her to come / I looked above and beyond / Awaiting my love / A sudden sound, I turned back / The crackle stopped, as so did my heart (D) Sitting by the pond / Awaiting my love / I looked above and beyond / A sudden scream, I looked around / Then a shadow fell and there was no sound / The crackle stopped, as so did my heart

subject: English
question: Why was Valli’s excitement on the bus dampened on her return journey ?
solution: On the return journey Valli saw the same cow that had earlier amused her lying dead on the roadside. The sight shocked and saddened her, changing her joyful mood and making her realise the harsh reality of death.

subject: English
chapter: The Tale of Custard the Dragon
question: Why does Custard long for a nice safe cage ?
solution: Custard is presented as a dragon who appears cowardly and prefers safety. He longs for a safe cage because he is afraid of danger and feels secure when protected, even though he proves to be genuinely brave when the pirate appears.

subject: English
chapter: Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
question: Why did Mandela feel that liberation was important for both, the oppressor and the oppressed ?
solution: Mandela believed that the oppressed needed freedom from injustice, while the oppressor also needed freedom from hatred, prejudice and narrow-mindedness. Apartheid deprived both sides of their humanity, so true liberation required freedom for everyone.

subject: English
question: Mention any three surprises that await visitors in Coorg.
solution: Visitors are surprised by Coorg’s evergreen rainforests, spice and coffee plantations, and the beautiful Brahmagiri hills. They can also experience the unique culture, wildlife and adventurous activities associated with the region.

subject: English
question: What does the poet mean by the phrase ‘And no one buys a ball back’ ?
solution: The phrase means that the emotional value attached to the lost ball cannot be recovered by buying another one. The boy must learn that some losses are permanent and that life requires accepting such losses.

subject: English
question: How do Anil’s initial reaction to Hari Singh’s cooking and his subsequent actions reflect Anil’s evolving relationship with Hari Singh ?
solution: Initially Anil disliked Hari’s cooking but decided to teach him. Later, he trusted him with household responsibilities and education. His patience, kindness and trust gradually turned their relationship from employer-servant to one based on affection and guidance.

subject: English
question: The unexpected encounter with the voice in the doorway affects Horace’s burglary attempt. Elaborate.
solution: The woman’s unexpected appearance makes Horace believe she is the owner of the house. She tricks him by claiming she needs the safe opened because she has forgotten its combination. Horace trusts her and opens it, allowing her to steal the jewels.

subject: English
chapter: The Book That Saved the Earth
question: The play, ‘The Book that Saved the Earth’, uses humour and misunderstandings between the Martians and Earthlings to explore the themes of perception and cultural differences. Comment.
solution: The Martians misunderstand ordinary nursery rhymes as descriptions of Earth’s military power. Their exaggerated interpretations create humour while showing how unfamiliar cultures can misread language and customs. The play highlights the importance of context and understanding in communication.

subject: English
chapter: A Letter to God and Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
question: Comment on the reactions and feelings of Lencho and Nelson Mandela when they faced challenges in their lives.
solution: Lencho faces the destruction of his crops with complete faith in God. Though he loses his harvest, he believes that God will help him and writes a letter asking for money. Mandela faces the much greater challenge of apartheid with courage, patience and determination. He sacrifices his freedom and personal life for equality and democracy. Both characters show strong faith and perseverance, though Lencho’s faith is religious and personal, while Mandela’s struggle is political, social and collective.

subject: English
chapter: The Tale of Custard the Dragon and The Proposal
question: Discuss how the writers use language to create humour in the poem ‘The Tale of Custard the Dragon’ and the play ‘The Proposal’.
solution: In ‘The Tale of Custard the Dragon’, humour comes from rhyme, exaggeration, repetition and the contrast between the characters’ claims of bravery and Custard’s actual courage. In ‘The Proposal’, humour develops through absurd arguments, exaggerated reactions and comic misunderstandings between Lomov, Natalya and Chubukov. The characters quarrel over trivial matters even while discussing marriage. Both texts use irony and exaggerated behaviour to create comedy while revealing human weaknesses.

subject: English
question: Why did Hari Singh choose to go back to Anil in the end ?
solution: Hari Singh returned because he realised that Anil’s trust and education could give him a better future than theft. After stealing the money, he felt guilty and understood that he would lose the opportunity to learn to read and write. Anil’s kindness had awakened Hari’s conscience. He therefore decided to return the stolen money and continue living honestly with Anil.

subject: English
question: What book opened the world of science to the eager Richard Ebright ? Why and where did Ebright send the tagged butterflies ?
solution: The book ‘The Travels of Monarch X’ opened the world of science to Richard Ebright. It encouraged his interest in monarch butterflies and scientific investigation. He tagged butterflies and sent them to the Zoologist at the University of Toronto to help study their migration patterns. This experience developed his scientific curiosity and introduced him to real research.

question: शेख अयाज़ के पिता ने अपनी बाँह पर काले च्योंटे को रेंगता देख क्या किया? इससे उनकी कौन-सी विशेषताएँ उभरकर आती हैं?
solution: शेख अयाज़ के पिता ने अपनी बाँह पर रेंग रहे च्योंटे को पानी से बाहर निकालकर फिर से पानी में डाल दिया। इससे उनकी जीव-जंतुओं के प्रति करुणा, संवेदनशीलता और मानवीयता प्रकट होती है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘झेन परंपरा की यह बड़ी देन मिली है जापानियों को।’ इस कथन में झेन परंपरा की किस बड़ी देन की बात कही गई है? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: झेन परंपरा जापानियों को मानसिक शांति, एकाग्रता, आत्मनियंत्रण और वर्तमान क्षण में जीने की कला देती है। इससे व्यक्ति तनाव और चिंता से मुक्त होकर शांत तथा संतुलित जीवन जी सकता है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘डायरी का एक पन्ना’ पाठ के आधार पर बताइए कि ‘ओपन लड़ाई’ किसे कहा गया है और यह अभूतपूर्व कैसे थी?
solution: ‘ओपन लड़ाई’ से आशय अंग्रेजी शासन के विरुद्ध जनता के खुले विरोध और स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन से है। इसमें स्त्री-पुरुष, बच्चे और सामान्य नागरिक बड़ी संख्या में शामिल हुए और निर्भय होकर स्वतंत्रता की माँग की।

subject: Hindi
question: मीरा अपने आराध्य कृष्ण से क्या विनती करती हैं और उन्हें उनके कर्तव्य का स्मरण कराने के लिए क्या करती हैं?
solution: मीरा अपने आराध्य कृष्ण से अपने दुख दूर करने और अपनी रक्षा करने की विनती करती हैं। वह कृष्ण को भक्तों के उद्धारक के रूप में याद करते हुए अपने भक्तवत्सल कर्तव्य का स्मरण कराती हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: विरासत में मिली वस्तुओं की सँभाल ज़रूरी है, क्यों? ‘तोप’ कविता के आधार पर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: विरासत में मिली वस्तुएँ हमारे इतिहास और अतीत की स्मृतियों को सुरक्षित रखती हैं। ‘तोप’ आज निष्क्रिय होकर बच्चों और चिड़ियों के लिए खेल का साधन बन गई है, इसलिए ऐसी ऐतिहासिक वस्तुओं का संरक्षण आवश्यक है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘आज धरती बनी है दुल्हन साथियो, अब तुम्हारे हवाले वतन साथियो।’ इन पंक्तियों के संदर्भ में सैनिक की भावनाओं को स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: सैनिक देश की रक्षा करते हुए अपने प्राणों का बलिदान देने के लिए तैयार हैं। वे अपने साथियों और आने वाली पीढ़ी को देश की जिम्मेदारी सौंपते हैं तथा मातृभूमि के प्रति प्रेम, त्याग और कर्तव्य की भावना व्यक्त करते हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘मैत्री धर्म, जाति, रंग-भेद, प्रतिष्ठा आदि से ऊपर शुद्ध प्रेम और भावनाओं का प्रतिबिंब है।’ ‘टोपी शुक्ला’ पाठ के आधार पर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: टोपी और इफ़्फ़न की मित्रता धर्म और जाति के भेद से परे थी। दोनों एक-दूसरे को सच्चे मन से समझते और अपनाते थे। उनका संबंध बताता है कि सच्ची मित्रता में धर्म, जाति और सामाजिक भेदभाव का कोई स्थान नहीं होता।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘सपनों के-से दिन’ पाठ के लेखक और उनके साथी किस प्रकार गर्मियों की छुट्टियाँ बिताया करते? आप गर्मी की छुट्टियों में क्या करते हैं, लिखिए।
solution: लेखक और उनके साथी गर्मियों की छुट्टियों में खेलते, घूमते और तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए समय बिताते थे। छुट्टियाँ उनके लिए आनंद और स्वतंत्रता से भरी होती थीं।

subject: Hindi
question: आपके पड़ोसी काका की स्थिति हरिहर काका से मिलती-जुलती है। आप उन्हें कैसे समझाएँगे और मदद करेंगे?
solution: मैं उनसे सहानुभूतिपूर्वक बात करूँगा, उनकी समस्याएँ समझूँगा और उन्हें अपने अधिकारों के प्रति जागरूक करूँगा। परिवार और समाज के विश्वसनीय लोगों की सहायता लेकर उनकी संपत्ति और सम्मान की रक्षा करने में मदद करूँगा।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘खेल बिना पाठ्यक्रम है अधूरा’ विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर अनुच्छेद लिखिए।
solution: खेल विद्यार्थियों के शारीरिक और मानसिक विकास के लिए आवश्यक हैं। खेलों से अनुशासन, सहयोग, नेतृत्व और आत्मविश्वास की भावना विकसित होती है। इसलिए खेल पाठ्यक्रम का अभिन्न अंग होने चाहिए और पढ़ाई के साथ खेलों में भी संतुलन बनाए रखना चाहिए।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘जब तक पहाड़-नदियाँ हैं तब तक जीवन है’ विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर अनुच्छेद लिखिए।
solution: प्रकृति मानव जीवन का आधार है। पहाड़ जल-स्रोतों और नदियों को जन्म देते हैं तथा नदियाँ जीवन, कृषि और पर्यावरण को बनाए रखती हैं। इसलिए प्रकृति से मित्रता और उसका संरक्षण सतत विकास के लिए आवश्यक है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘बेटी बचाओ, बेटी पढ़ाओ’ विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर अनुच्छेद लिखिए।
solution: बेटियाँ समाज का अभिन्न अंग हैं। उन्हें शिक्षा और समान अवसर मिलने से वे आत्मनिर्भर और सशक्त बनती हैं। बेटियों की शिक्षा परिवार और समाज के विकास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है। इसलिए बेटियों को बचाना, पढ़ाना और आगे बढ़ाना आवश्यक है।

subject: Hindi
question: आपके क्षेत्र में स्थित स्टेडियम के स्थापना दिवस की वर्षगाँठ के अवसर पर दिव्यांग बच्चों द्वारा भी अपनी प्रतिभा का प्रदर्शन किया जाएगा। इस कार्यक्रम के सीधे प्रसारण की प्रार्थना करते हुए दूरदर्शन निदेशक को लगभग 100 शब्दों में पत्र लिखिए।
solution: पत्र में कार्यक्रम की जानकारी देते हुए दिव्यांग बच्चों की प्रतिभा के प्रदर्शन के सीधे प्रसारण का अनुरोध किया जाएगा तथा इस प्रसारण से अधिक लोगों तक बच्चों की प्रतिभा और प्रेरणादायक प्रयास पहुँचने की बात कही जाएगी।

subject: Hindi
question: अपने नगर की ऐतिहासिक इमारतों की दयनीय स्थिति पर चिंता व्यक्त करते हुए उनके उचित रख-रखाव के लिए अध्यक्ष, पुरातत्त्व विभाग को लगभग 100 शब्दों में पत्र लिखिए।
solution: पत्र में ऐतिहासिक इमारतों की जर्जर स्थिति, उनकी ऐतिहासिक महत्ता तथा उचित रख-रखाव की आवश्यकता बताकर पुरातत्त्व विभाग से शीघ्र संरक्षण, मरम्मत और नियमित देखभाल की व्यवस्था करने का अनुरोध किया जाएगा।

subject: Hindi
question: विद्यालय के सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम के सचिव की ओर से बाल कलाकारों द्वारा नाट्य प्रस्तुति की सूचना लगभग 60 शब्दों में लिखिए।
solution: सूचना में नाट्य प्रस्तुति की तिथि, समय, स्थान तथा बाल कलाकारों की भागीदारी की जानकारी देते हुए विद्यार्थियों से कार्यक्रम में उपस्थित होने का अनुरोध किया जाएगा।

subject: Hindi
question: आपके विद्यालय में क्षेत्रीय पुलिस द्वारा स्वरक्षा प्रशिक्षण शिविर का आयोजन किया जा रहा है। छात्राओं तक इसकी जानकारी पहुँचाने के लिए लगभग 60 शब्दों में सूचना लिखिए।
solution: सूचना में स्वरक्षा प्रशिक्षण शिविर की तिथि, समय, स्थान, प्रशिक्षण का उद्देश्य तथा छात्राओं के लिए पंजीकरण संबंधी जानकारी दी जाएगी और अधिक से अधिक छात्राओं को भाग लेने के लिए प्रेरित किया जाएगा।

subject: Hindi

solution: नवीन विद्यालय में आधुनिक शिक्षा, अनुभवी शिक्षक, बेहतर सुविधाएँ और सुरक्षित वातावरण उपलब्ध हैं। आगामी सत्र में प्रवेश लेने वाले स्थानीय बच्चों के लिए विशेष छूट। सीमित सीटें—आज ही प्रवेश लें।

solution: मनुष्य ने पक्षियों की तरह छोटा होकर पेड़ों पर बने छोटे-छोटे घरों में रहना शुरू किया। इससे वह प्रकृति के बहुत करीब आ गया। उसने पेड़ों, पक्षियों और पर्यावरण का महत्व समझा और जंगलों को बचाने का संकल्प लिया। धीरे-धीरे शहरों में हरियाली बढ़ी और मानव तथा प्रकृति के बीच संतुलन स्थापित होने लगा।

subject: Hindi

question: 'पिता ____ की तरह दिन-रात काम में लगे रहते हैं और इसे मौज़ मस्ती से फुरसत नहीं है।' - रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए उपयुक्त मुहावरा चयन कर लिखिए। (A) खाक छानना (B) अड़ियल टट्टू (C) कोल्हू का बैल (D) दूध की मक्खी
solution: (C) कोल्हू का बैल

subject: Hindi
question: निम्नलिखित में से 'ऊँचाई पर होना' अर्थ के लिए उचित मुहावरा है— (A) खुशी का ठिकाना न रहना (B) लोहे के चने चबाना (C) तीर मारना (D) सातवें आसमान पर होना
solution: (D) सातवें आसमान पर होना

subject: Hindi
question: गद्यांश में आई पंक्ति - 'पहले पूरा संसार एक परिवार के समान था अब टुकड़ों में बँटकर एक-दूसरे से दूर हो चुका है।' का भाव है— (A) संसार देश और प्रांत में बँट चुका है। (B) संयुक्त परिवार एकल परिवारों में बँट गए हैं। (C) वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम् की भावना समाप्त हो गई है। (D) एक देश से दूसरे देश को जाना कठिन हो गया है।
solution: (C) वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम् की भावना समाप्त हो गई है।

subject: Hindi
question: गद्यांश में प्रयुक्त 'छोटे-छोटे डिब्बे जैसे घर' - संकेत करते हैं— (A) फ्लैट संस्कृति की ओर (B) छोटे-छोटे घरों की ओर (C) एक कमरे के घरों की ओर (D) बहुमंजिला इमारतों की ओर
solution: (A) फ्लैट संस्कृति की ओर

subject: Hindi
question: बढ़ती हुई आबादी को बसाने के लिए क्या नहीं किया गया? (A) समंदर की जमीन को हथियाना शुरू कर दिया गया। (B) वन प्रदेश का सफाया करना शुरू कर दिया गया। (C) पशु-पक्षियों को घर से बेघर कर दिया गया। (D) खनिज पदार्थों का मनमाना दोहन किया गया।
solution: (D) खनिज पदार्थों का मनमाना दोहन किया गया।

subject: Hindi
question: गद्यांश के अनुसार बढ़ती प्राकृतिक हानि किसका परिणाम है? (A) दिनोंदिन बढ़ने वाले प्रदूषण का (B) मनुष्य के बढ़ते लालच का (C) मानव और प्रकृति के बीच असंतुलन का (D) पर्वतीय प्रदेशों में होने वाले कटाव का
solution: (C) मानव और प्रकृति के बीच असंतुलन का

subject: Hindi
question: कथन: फैलते हुए प्रदूषण ने पंछियों को बस्तियों से भगाना शुरू कर दिया है। कारण: मानव ने अपनी बुद्धि से बड़ी-बड़ी दीवारें खड़ी कर दी हैं।
solution: (C) कथन सही है, लेकिन कारण उसकी गलत व्याख्या करता है।

subject: Hindi
question: 'तीसरी कसम के शिल्पकार शैलेंद्र' पाठ के आधार पर उत्तर दीजिए कि फिल्मों में त्रासद स्थितियों की भी प्रशंसा (ग्लोरीफाई) क्यों की जाती है? (A) अधिक से अधिक धन कमाने हेतु (B) दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने हेतु (C) अधिकाधिक लोकप्रियता पाने हेतु (D) दर्शकों का भावात्मक शोषण करने हेतु
solution: (D) दर्शकों का भावात्मक शोषण करने हेतु

subject: Hindi
question: 'बड़े भाई साहब' पाठ के कथानायक के आँसू बहाने का कारण है— (A) आगे की कक्षा की कठिन पढ़ाई का डर (B) बड़े भाई साहब की डाँट-फटकार (C) अम्मा-बाबा की याद आना (D) अध्यापकों की डाँट-फटकार
solution: (B) बड़े भाई साहब की डाँट-फटकार

subject: Hindi
question: 'कस्तूरी कुंडलि बसै, मृग हूँ बन माँहि। ऐसैं घटि घटि राँम है, दुनियाँ देखै नाँहिं।' दोहे में किसका वर्णन किया गया है? (A) कस्तूरी ढूँढने वाले मृग का (B) सांसारिकता में लीन मानव का (C) अपनी ही विशेषता से अनजान मनुष्य का (D) ईश्वर की सर्वव्यापकता का
solution: (C) अपनी ही विशेषता से अनजान मनुष्य का

subject: Hindi
question: 'जब मैं था तब हरि नहीं' पंक्ति में 'मैं' से अभिप्राय है— (A) अहंकार की भावना (B) स्वार्थ की भावना (C) सांसारिक माया-मोह (D) स्वयं कवि
solution: (A) अहंकार की भावना

subject: Hindi
question: 'जब मैं था तब हरि नहीं' दोहे के अनुसार हृदय में ईश्वर का निवास कब तक असंभव है? (A) जब तक सच्चे हृदय से उसे याद न किया जाए। (B) जब तक सांसारिक विषय-वासनाओं को न छोड़ा जाए। (C) जब तक अहंकारपूर्ण व्यवहार का नाश न किया जाए। (D) जब तक सच्चे हृदय से उसकी सेवा न की जाए।
solution: (C) जब तक अहंकारपूर्ण व्यवहार का नाश न किया जाए।

subject: Hindi
question: 'जब दीपक देख्या माँहि' - पंक्ति में 'दीपक' प्रतीकार्थ है— (A) प्रभु प्रेम के प्रकाश का (B) रोशनी के साधन का (C) प्रकाश का (D) संपन्नता का
solution: (A) प्रभु प्रेम के प्रकाश का

subject: Hindi
question: कथन: ईश्वर सृष्टि के कण-कण में निवास करते हैं पर हम उन्हें देख नहीं पाते। कारण: मनुष्य के पास दिव्य-दृष्टि नहीं है।
solution: (D) कथन तथा कारण दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण कथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

subject: Hindi
question: 'दूसरे का सहारा बनते हुए निरंतर आगे बढ़ो' इस भाव को व्यक्त करने वाली पंक्ति है— (A) रहो न यों कि एक से न काम और का सरे (B) अतर्क एक पंथ के सतर्क पंथ हो सभी (C) परस्परावलंब से उठो तथा बढ़ो सभी (D) तभी समर्थ भाव है कि तारता हुआ तरे
solution: (C) परस्परावलंब से उठो तथा बढ़ो सभी

subject: Hindi
question: 'पर्वत प्रदेश में पावस' कविता के आधार पर लिखिए कि जल में बार-बार कौन झाँक रहा है? (A) पर्वत (B) झरना (C) तरुवर (D) पुष्प
solution: (C) तरुवर

subject: Hindi
question: 'बड़े भाई साहब' कहानी से उद्धृत पंक्ति - 'बुनियाद ही पुख्ता न हो तो, मकान कैसे पायदार बने।' - का आशय स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: बड़े भाई साहब का आशय है कि किसी भी कार्य में सफलता के लिए आधार मजबूत होना चाहिए। शिक्षा में भी पहले बुनियादी ज्ञान और समझ पक्की होनी चाहिए, तभी आगे की पढ़ाई स्थायी और सफल बन सकती है।

subject: Hindi
question: 'तीसरी कसम के शिल्पकार शैलेंद्र' पाठ के आधार पर सिद्ध कीजिए कि सिनेमा की चकाचौंध के बीच रहते हुए भी शैलेंद्र यश और धन-लिप्सा से कोसों दूर थे।
solution: शैलेंद्र सिनेमा में रहते हुए भी व्यावसायिक सफलता और धन के पीछे नहीं भागते थे। उन्होंने संवेदनशील और साहित्यिक मूल्यों वाली फिल्म बनाई। उनका उद्देश्य कला और मानवीय संवेदनाओं को सामने लाना था, न कि केवल प्रसिद्धि और धन कमाना।

subject: Hindi
question: 'कारतूस' एकांकी के आधार पर लिखिए कि लेफ्टीनेंट को वजीर अली 'भूत' क्यों नज़र आ रहा था?
solution: वजीर अली अंग्रेजों के लिए अत्यंत साहसी और खतरनाक व्यक्ति था। वह अंग्रेजी शासन के विरुद्ध संघर्ष कर रहा था और बार-बार उनकी योजनाओं को विफल कर रहा था। उसकी वीरता, साहस और रहस्यमय ढंग से सामने आना लेफ्टीनेंट को उसे 'भूत' जैसा समझने पर मजबूर करता था।

subject: Hindi
question: 'कर चले हम फिदा' कविता से उद्धृत - 'साँस थमती गई, नब्ज जमती गई' - पंक्ति के संदर्भ में सैनिक जीवन की कठिनाइयों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
solution: सैनिकों को युद्धभूमि में अत्यंत कठिन परिस्थितियों का सामना करना पड़ता है। वे ठंड, भूख, थकान, चोट और मृत्यु के भय के बीच भी देश की रक्षा करते हैं। उनके लिए व्यक्तिगत जीवन से अधिक राष्ट्र की सुरक्षा महत्त्वपूर्ण होती है।

subject: Hindi
question: कविता के आधार पर लिखिए कि पूर्वजों से मिली धरोहर का क्या महत्त्व है? इन्हें सँभालकर क्यों रखा जाता है?
solution: पूर्वजों से मिली धरोहर हमारी संस्कृति, इतिहास और पारिवारिक स्मृतियों से जुड़ी होती है। इन्हें सँभालकर रखने से आने वाली पीढ़ियों को अपनी जड़ों, परंपराओं और पूर्वजों के जीवन-मूल्यों से परिचित होने का अवसर मिलता है।

subject: Hindi
question: मीरा के 'पद' के आधार पर लिखिए कि द्रौपदी, प्रहलाद आदि का उल्लेख कर मीरा भगवान को उनका कौन-सा रूप स्मरण करवा रही है और क्यों?
solution: मीरा द्रौपदी, प्रहलाद आदि के प्रसंगों द्वारा भगवान के रक्षक और भक्तवत्सल रूप का स्मरण करवा रही हैं। वह विश्वास व्यक्त करती हैं कि जिस प्रकार भगवान ने अपने भक्तों की रक्षा की, उसी प्रकार वे मीरा की भी रक्षा करेंगे।

subject: Hindi
question: हरिहर काका की जमीन हड़पने के लिए महंत द्वारा धर्म, माया-मोह का सहारा लिया गया, अपहरण करवाया गया। उनका ऐसा करना आपकी दृष्टि में कितना उचित है? तर्कपूर्ण उत्तर दीजिए।
solution: महंत का ऐसा करना बिल्कुल अनुचित था। उसने धर्म और माया-मोह जैसे भावनात्मक साधनों का उपयोग अपने स्वार्थ के लिए किया और हरिहर काका की स्वतंत्रता का भी उल्लंघन किया। किसी की संपत्ति पाने के लिए छल, दबाव और अपहरण नैतिक रूप से गलत हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: 'उम्र का फासला आत्मीय संबंधों में बाधा नहीं बनता।' 'हरिहर काका' और 'टोपी शुक्ला' कहानी के आधार पर सिद्ध कीजिए।
solution: आत्मीय संबंध उम्र के अंतर पर नहीं बल्कि प्रेम, विश्वास और अपनत्व पर आधारित होते हैं। हरिहर काका और टोपी शुक्ला जैसे पात्रों के संबंध यह दिखाते हैं कि सच्चा लगाव उम्र की सीमाओं से परे होता है।

subject: Hindi
question: 'सपनों के से दिन' पाठ के आधार पर लिखिए कि बच्चों का खेलकूद में अधिक रुचि लेना अभिभावकों को अप्रिय क्यों लगता है? पढ़ाई के साथ खेलों का छात्र जीवन में क्या महत्त्व है? इससे किन जीवन-मूल्यों की प्रेरणा मिलती है?
solution: अभिभावकों को लगता है कि खेलकूद से पढ़ाई प्रभावित होगी, इसलिए वे बच्चों की अधिक खेल रुचि को पसंद नहीं करते। परंतु खेल शारीरिक स्वास्थ्य, मानसिक प्रसन्नता और अनुशासन के लिए आवश्यक हैं। इससे सहयोग, नेतृत्व, धैर्य, आत्मविश्वास और टीम भावना जैसे जीवन-मूल्य विकसित होते हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में अनुच्छेद लिखिए: (क) ध्वनि प्रदूषण — संकेत बिंदु: अर्थ, इसके कारण, हानि, समाधान।
solution: ध्वनि प्रदूषण का अर्थ आवश्यकता से अधिक और कर्कश ध्वनि से होने वाला प्रदूषण है। वाहनों के हॉर्न, लाउडस्पीकर, मशीनों और पटाखों से यह बढ़ता है। इससे मानसिक तनाव, नींद में बाधा और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याएँ हो सकती हैं। इसे रोकने के लिए अनावश्यक हॉर्न और तेज ध्वनि पर नियंत्रण, ध्वनि-सीमा का पालन तथा जन-जागरूकता आवश्यक है।

subject: Hindi
question: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में अनुच्छेद लिखिए: (ख) मेरा प्रिय खिलाड़ी — संकेत बिंदु: नाम, प्रिय लगने के गुण/कारण, उनके जैसा बनने की इच्छा।
solution: मेरा प्रिय खिलाड़ी वह है जो अपने खेल के साथ अनुशासन, मेहनत और संघर्ष की भावना के लिए भी जाना जाता है। उसकी लगन और आत्मविश्वास मुझे प्रेरित करते हैं। वह कठिन परिस्थितियों में भी हार नहीं मानता। मैं भी उसके जैसा मेहनती, अनुशासित और दृढ़ निश्चयी बनना चाहता हूँ।

subject: Hindi
question: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक विषय पर दिए गए संकेत-बिंदुओं के आधार पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में अनुच्छेद लिखिए: (ग) परहित सरिस धर्म नहि भाई — संकेत बिंदु: अर्थ, जीवन की सार्थकता, आनंद का स्रोत।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘पर्वत प्रदेश में पावस’ कविता में वर्णित पर्वतीय प्रदेश की सुंदरता का वर्णन अपने शब्दों में कीजिए।
solution: वर्षा ऋतु में पर्वतीय प्रदेश अत्यंत सुंदर दिखाई देता है। पर्वत, झरने, बादल, तालाब और हरियाली मिलकर प्राकृतिक सौंदर्य को मनमोहक बना देते हैं। बादलों के आने से पूरा वातावरण रहस्यमय और आकर्षक हो जाता है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘तोप’ कविता के आधार पर तोप और चिड़िया की प्रतीकात्मकता स्पष्ट करते हुए लिखिए कि इस कविता के माध्यम से कवि ने क्या संदेश दिया है?
solution: तोप सत्ता और हिंसा का प्रतीक है, जबकि चिड़िया स्वतंत्रता और जीवन की सहजता का प्रतीक है। कविता बताती है कि समय के साथ हिंसा और दमन की शक्ति समाप्त हो जाती है तथा जीवन और स्वतंत्रता विजयी होते हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘कर चले हम फ़िदा’ कविता में उद्धृत ‘तोड़ दे हाथ अगर हाथ उठने लगे’ पंक्ति के संदर्भ में लिखिए कि सैनिक देशवासियों से क्या अपेक्षा रखते हैं?
solution: सैनिक चाहते हैं कि देशवासी देश की रक्षा के लिए साहसपूर्वक आगे आएँ। यदि कोई शत्रु देश की ओर हाथ बढ़ाए तो उसे दृढ़ता से रोकें और देश की स्वतंत्रता तथा सम्मान की रक्षा करें।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘बड़े भाई साहब’ कहानी के अंत में बड़े भाई साहब पतंग की डोर थामे भागते जाते हैं। उनका इस तरह दौड़े जाना किस सिद्ध करता है? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: यह सिद्ध करता है कि बड़े भाई साहब भी भीतर से बाल-सुलभ और पतंग उड़ाने के शौकीन थे। वे केवल छोटे भाई को अनुशासन और पढ़ाई का उपदेश देते थे, पर स्वयं भी खेल और मनोरंजन की इच्छा रखते थे।

concept: आज जो कुछ हुआ वह अद्भुत था
question: ‘डायरी का एक पन्ना’ पाठ में उद्धृत ‘आज जो कुछ हुआ वह अद्भुत था।’ - पंक्ति का आशय स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: इस पंक्ति में लेखक ने स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के दौरान जनता के अद्भुत साहस, एकता और देशभक्ति को व्यक्त किया है। लोगों ने अंग्रेजी शासन की परवाह किए बिना जुलूस और आंदोलन में भाग लिया।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘ऐन की डायरी’ पाठ में जापानियों के मानसिक रोग का कारण उनका अमेरिका से प्रतिस्पर्धी बताया गया है। आप इस कारण को कितना उचित मानते हैं? आपकी दृष्टि में जीवन में प्रतिस्पर्धा की क्या भूमिका है? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
solution: अत्यधिक प्रतिस्पर्धा मानसिक तनाव और असंतोष का कारण बन सकती है। स्वस्थ प्रतिस्पर्धा व्यक्ति को आगे बढ़ने के लिए प्रेरित करती है, लेकिन अंधी प्रतिस्पर्धा मानसिक शांति और संतुलन को प्रभावित करती है।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘हरिहर काका’ कहानी समाज के किन पहलुओं की ओर हमारा ध्यान आकर्षित करती है? आप अपने आस-पास रहे ऐसे उदाहरणों से क्या सीख लेते हैं?
solution: कहानी स्वार्थ, संपत्ति के लालच, पारिवारिक उपेक्षा और धार्मिक पाखंड की ओर ध्यान आकर्षित करती है। इससे सीख मिलती है कि संबंधों में स्वार्थ नहीं बल्कि सम्मान, विश्वास और संवेदना होनी चाहिए।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘भरे-पूरे परिवार में रहता हुआ भी व्यक्ति अकेला हो सकता है।’ ‘हरिहर काका’ और ‘टोपी शुक्ला’ कहानी के आधार पर इस कथन को सिद्ध कीजिए।
solution: परिवार में रहने मात्र से अपनापन नहीं मिलता। हरिहर काका को परिवार ने संपत्ति के कारण उपेक्षित किया और टोपी को भी भावनात्मक अपनापन नहीं मिला। दोनों पात्रों की स्थिति बताती है कि संवेदना और समझ आवश्यक हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘सपनों के-से दिन’ पाठ में अंग्रेजों द्वारा गाँव के लोगों को सोना में भर्ती करने के लिए नोटंकी का सहारा लिया गया। वर्तमान समय में प्रचार-प्रसार के साधनों में क्या अंतर आया है?
solution: पहले प्रचार के लिए नाटक, नौटंकी और मौखिक माध्यमों का सहारा लिया जाता था। आज टेलीविजन, समाचार-पत्र, इंटरनेट, सोशल मीडिया और डिजिटल माध्यम प्रचार के प्रमुख साधन बन गए हैं।

subject: Hindi
question: कृत्रिम बौद्धिकता (आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस) के बढ़ते कदम विषय पर दिए गए संकेत बिंदुओं के आधार पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में अनुच्छेद लिखिए। संकेत बिंदु: क्या है कृत्रिम बौद्धिकता, बढ़ता प्रभाव, संभावित खतरा।
solution: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता ऐसी तकनीक है जिसमें मशीनें मानव की तरह सीखने, समझने और निर्णय लेने का प्रयास करती हैं। आज शिक्षा, चिकित्सा, व्यापार, संचार और उद्योग में इसका प्रभाव तेजी से बढ़ रहा है। इससे कार्य सरल और तेज हो रहे हैं, लेकिन रोजगार में कमी, निजता का खतरा और तकनीक के दुरुपयोग जैसी समस्याएँ भी सामने आ सकती हैं। इसलिए कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता का विकास जिम्मेदारी और मानवीय मूल्यों के साथ किया जाना चाहिए।

subject: Hindi
question: जब मुझे मेरा निजी स्मार्ट फोन मिला विषय पर दिए गए संकेत बिंदुओं के आधार पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में अनुच्छेद लिखिए। संकेत बिंदु: कब और क्यों मिला? अवर्णनीय खुशी का अनुभव, मित्रों और संबंधियों के साथ खुशी बाँटना।
solution: जब मुझे मेरा निजी स्मार्ट फोन मिला तो मुझे बहुत खुशी हुई। मुझे यह फोन पढ़ाई और आवश्यक संपर्क के लिए मिला। फोन मिलने पर मुझे लगा कि अब मैं अनेक काम स्वयं आसानी से कर सकता हूँ। मैंने अपने मित्रों और संबंधियों को यह खुशी बताई और उनके साथ अपना उत्साह साझा किया। स्मार्ट फोन से पढ़ाई, जानकारी प्राप्त करने और संपर्क बनाए रखने में सुविधा हुई।

subject: Hindi
question: ‘दैव-दैव आलसी पुकारा’ विषय पर लगभग 100 शब्दों में लघुकथा लिखिए।
solution: एक व्यक्ति हमेशा अपनी असफलता का दोष भाग्य को देता था। वह मेहनत नहीं करता और कहता कि समय आने पर सब अपने आप मिल जाएगा। एक दिन उसके मित्र ने उसे समझाया कि केवल भाग्य पर निर्भर रहने से सफलता नहीं मिलती। उसने मेहनत शुरू की और धीरे-धीरे उसके काम सफल होने लगे। तब उसे समझ आया कि कर्म ही सफलता का आधार है।

subject: Hindi
question: विद्यालय में आयोजित होने वाली दोहा-गायन प्रतियोगिता के लिए साहित्यिक क्लब के सचिव दिनेश की ओर से विद्यालय के सूचना पट पर लिखे जाने हेतु लगभग 60 शब्दों में एक सूचना तैयार कीजिए।
solution: विद्यालय के सभी विद्यार्थियों को सूचित किया जाता है कि साहित्यिक क्लब द्वारा दोहा-गायन प्रतियोगिता आयोजित की जा रही है। इच्छुक विद्यार्थी निर्धारित तिथि तक अपना नाम साहित्यिक क्लब के सचिव के पास दर्ज कराएँ। प्रतियोगिता में चयनित प्रतिभागियों को विद्यालय की ओर से प्रमाण-पत्र प्रदान किए जाएँगे।

subject: Hindi
question: विद्यालय के समाज सेवा परिषद की ओर से कक्षा ग्यारहवीं और बारहवीं के छात्रों के लिए लगभग 60 शब्दों में एक सूचना तैयार कीजिए जिसमें एक सप्ताह तक प्रौढ़ों की साक्षरता हेतु शिविर में भाग लेने वाले छात्रों से पंजीकरण हेतु नाम देने की जानकारी दी गई हो।
solution: समाज सेवा परिषद द्वारा कक्षा ग्यारहवीं और बारहवीं के विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक सप्ताह का प्रौढ़ साक्षरता शिविर आयोजित किया जा रहा है। इच्छुक विद्यार्थी शिविर में भाग लेने हेतु अपना नाम परिषद के पास निर्धारित तिथि तक पंजीकृत कराएँ।

subject: Hindi
question: किसी दैनिक समाचार-पत्र में प्रकाशित करने के लिए लगभग 40 शब्दों में एक विज्ञापन का प्रारूप तैयार कीजिए जिसमें आवश्यक दस्तावेज यात्रा के समय मार्ग में खो जाने का उल्लेख हो।
solution: आवश्यक दस्तावेज खो गए हैं। यात्रा के दौरान मार्ग में दस्तावेजों का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण पैकेट कहीं गिर गया है। इसमें आवश्यक प्रमाण-पत्र और पहचान संबंधी दस्तावेज हैं। पाने वाले व्यक्ति से अनुरोध है कि दिए गए संपर्क पर सूचना देकर सहयोग करें।

subject: Hindi
question: आर्थिक दृष्टि से कमजोर छात्रों को निःशुल्क शिक्षण सुविधा उपलब्ध कराने हेतु क.ख.ग. स्कूल की ओर से एक आकर्षक विज्ञापन लगभग 40 शब्दों में तैयार कीजिए।

solution: अपने बच्चे की मृत्यु का समाचार सुनकर माँ के जिगर के टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो गए।
